conviction_note: A heavily covered large-cap whose quarterly inflows are already public monthly, with no live bid since MPS's offer lapsed on 29 Oct. What the release adds is October inflows, probably a higher 2026 inflow target, and Q3 performance fees and tax that proxies suggest are soft. These roughly offset (impact_sum -0.15), so p_up sits at 52 and the scaled number is +0.16 on a 4.0% unsigned move. That move is sized on the name's actual results-day reactions (+2.7, -7.6, +5.7, -0.15) and not on the baseline's cadence estimate.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 performance fees are likely at or below the ~EUR 15m bar, and far below Q2's EUR 79.2m and Q3 2025's EUR 29m. European equities were flat to down over the quarter (Stoxx 600 -1.1%, FTSE MIB -0.6%, 30 Jun -> 30 Sep 2026, Yahoo closes), and peer Azimut booked negative Q3 variable fees ('Commissioni di gestione variabili ... 3Q 2026 (4.994)' vs +2.212m in 3Q25).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026, with strong variable fees and a record quarter, rose 5.65% on the day. H1 2026, with variable fees nearly tripled at EUR 125.8m, moved -0.15%. The market discounts variable fees and reads recurring profit.
findings.original_quote: Commissioni di gestione variabili 5.232 / 2.732 / 2.212 / (4.994) [9M25 / 9M26 / 3Q25 / 3Q26, EUR 000]; and Medda: 'la debolezza dell'ultimo mese, in cui una vera e propria tempesta perfetta ... e il rialzo dei tassi in Europa e negli Stati Uniti' (variable management fees; 'the weakness of the last month, a real perfect storm ... and the rise in rates in Europe and the US')
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Equita already cut performance fees to EUR 15m. If the market had priced a near-zero quarter, the broker bar would sit below 15m. Barclays raised BGN's target on 2 Nov, and the stock bounced 3% off its 30 Oct low into the print. Azimut's scheme differs from BG FML's, so this is a proxy and is sized small.
findings.independence: The broad index series (Stoxx 600 and FTSE MIB Q3 returns from Yahoo, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/FTSEMIB.MI?range=6mo&interval=1d) points the same way, as does Equita's own cut versus Q3 2025 (https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/equita-punta-su-banca-mediolanum-in-vista-dei-conti-2720501)

findings.finding: October net inflows (first published in this release) and a probable raise to the 2026 net-inflow target. YTD is already EUR 6.3bn against a ~EUR 7.5bn guide, so the guide needs only ~EUR 1.2bn over Q4. Equita expects ~EUR 8bn. Industry October flows were strong for Italian networks (Fineco preliminary October EUR 1.7bn, +28% y/y) on the back of the EUR 16.6bn BTP Valore placement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 2026 inflow-guidance raise (from >6.5bn to ~7.5bn) moved -0.15%. 9M 2025, which carried October 2025's EUR 1.18bn, rose 2.72%. The 7 Oct 2026 September-inflow release (a record September) fell 3.15% on the day.
findings.original_quote: Banca Generali ha deciso di rivedere al rialzo i propri obiettivi di crescita puntando a realizzare una raccolta netta per l'anno in corso a circa €7,5 miliardi (in aumento dai precedenti >€6,5 miliardi) (Banca Generali decided to raise its growth targets, aiming for net inflows of about EUR 7.5bn this year, up from >EUR 6.5bn)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Equita publicly models ~8bn, and monthly inflows are released, so a raise to ~8bn is the expected print; only a larger raise or a strong AUI mix would surprise. The BTP Valore flow also lands in administered assets with low margin, and Jefferies flags it as a drain on deposits. That limits how much a headline inflow beat is worth.
findings.independence: Fineco October flows (https://www.websim.it/azioni/blue-chip/fineco-risultati-del-terzo-trimestre-2026-superiori-alle-aspettative/, 2026-11-05) point the same way. Azimut's October was weak (~EUR 30m), but for Brazil/Turkey reasons outside BGN's domestic market (https://euroborsa.it/public/euroborsa/Comunicati_Stampa/Azimut/Azimut_5_novembre_2026.pdf)

findings.finding: The 2027 Italian budget raises bank IRES by 3 points and cuts IRAP deductibility, so BGN's medium-term tax-rate guide (27-28% from 2028, which already includes the previous budget's IRAP rise) is likely to be revised upward. Equita estimates the sector EPS 2027 hit at -4 to -4.5%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior BGN print with a tax-guide change was found. The BG FML extra-tax disclosure in H1 2026 came on a -0.15% day.
findings.original_quote: effetto negativo medio sull'utile per azione 2027 delle banche italiane compreso tra il 4% e il 4,5% (average negative effect on Italian banks' 2027 EPS of 4-4.5%)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced. MF wrote 'In larga parte il mercato lo aveva già scontato' (the market had largely already discounted it), and the measure is sector-wide and public since late October. Only a BGN-specific quantification above the sector average would add anything, and asset-light networks are described as more resilient.
findings.independence: https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/al-riparo-dalla-manovra-2722670 (2026-10-31): the same 4-4.5% EPS range, and networks such as Mediolanum and Fineco 'reggono bene' (hold up well)

findings.finding: The BG FML Luxembourg tax charge should continue in Q3. H1 booked EUR 19.6m for January-June as the 'massimo esborso potenzialmente applicabile' (maximum potentially applicable outlay), which implies roughly EUR 10m more for Q3 unless an update arrives. It is non-recurring and sits below operating income, with management guiding toward normalisation by 2028.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First disclosed with H1 2026 results: -0.15% on the day.
findings.original_quote: L'onere, riferito al periodo compreso tra gennaio e giugno 2026, rappresenta il massimo esborso potenzialmente applicabile sulla base dell'attuale quadro normativo (The charge, for January-June 2026, is the maximum outlay potentially applicable under the current framework)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the run-rate is arithmetic from the H1 release and is excluded from recurring profit, which is what the market trades. Jefferies raising 2026 EPS 5% 'grazie a un minor carico fiscale' (thanks to a lower tax burden) suggests at least one broker expects relief. The sign of any update is therefore genuinely two-way, hence the wide range around a small negative.
findings.independence: https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/wealth-management-italiano-jefferies-debolezza-dipende-da-maggiore-costo-del-capitale-proprio-109_2026-10-29_TLB.html?lang=it (Jefferies, 2026-10-29) cuts the other way on the tax line, so the evidence is mixed

outside_window.finding: Industrial plan, once due in November 2026 and possibly postponed again during the MPS offer. With the offer lapsed, a plan or capital-markets day with capital-return targets (CET1 17.2%) is the bigger re-rating event, but no date inside the window was found. The release may only announce a date.

baseline_tension: Little tension: the lean (+0.11) and run-up (20d -2.2%, 5d +2.3%, 60d -8.5% as the MPS deal premium unwound) are near neutral, and the findings net to about zero (-0.15). The proxies point soft on performance fees and tax, while the guidance line and October flows point mildly firm.
language_note: The Italian eMarket STORAGE filings carried the release timestamps (12:56 and 12:30 CET) that settle the session. The English IR pages give no times.
The Italian H1 text carried the BG FML tax wording ('massimo esborso potenzialmente applicabile') and the 2026 guidance block, which the English wire summaries compress.
Italian press (MF/Equita, Teleborsa) carried the only line-by-line Q3 broker bar and the Jefferies and Barclays sector notes. No English source turned up the Equita numbers.
Italian press carried the MPS offer terms and the 29 Oct lapse vote and the UniCredit rumour. These explain the 60-day drawdown, which English search did not surface.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' plus understatement as the systematic error: abs_move_pct raised from 3.5 to 4.0, because an inflow-guide raise and a possible tax-guide change are in play, and the name's real results-day moves include -7.6 and +5.7.
A sector fact the market has already been told is worth ~0: the 2027-budget tax finding cut from -0.3 to -0.15, since MF reports it largely discounted.
'In a live bid, results are noise' was checked: the MPS offer lapsed on 29 Oct and there is no live offer, so results are treated as the event.
